title: Spring Break entertainment now streaming onboard with AirFi
summary: Stream movies, shows, games, and playlists with Sun Country Airlines’ AirFi inflight entertainment. Free, simple, and ready for every spring break getaway.
body_markdown:
Whether you’re escaping winter, heading somewhere sunny, or squeezing in a quick spring break trip, AirFi is ready to keep you entertained from takeoff to landing.


No apps, no fees, no hassle. Connect to our AirFi network on your own device and dive into a refreshed mix of movies, familiar TV favorites, easy games, and playlists that match the spring break mood. It’s simple, included, and makes the flight part of the fun.


Get comfortable, grab a drink, and let great stories, sounds, and games carry you to your getaway.
